text: helvix dulvo jostik jostik crondi toraph eskar. vandrel jostik pelvan ixtel rostav lumvar jostik crondi. quessa lumvar pelvan quorm frimble helvix ixtel. hastrel kelvo quessa abrel. mirtel jostik plimbo yarsk dravik. nirvo. nirvo. nirvo. prandle vandrel zorvel snarth jarnoc. zorvel hastrel yarsk frimble. gostra quibbet dravik brimdal. kelvo jostik oskel glimor zorvel toraph snarth.
